summary: Add marketing_opt_in column with DB DEFAULT FALSE, backfill all rows, deploy new version with state-only migration, retire old version, then alter column to NOT NULL. Moving the contract stage after retire_old satisfies the retirement gate check that refused the prior plan.
write_consistency: Old version INSERTs omit marketing_opt_in, receiving DB default FALSE; new version save() explicitly sets False. After retire_old, column is altered to NOT NULL. During concurrent traffic, DEFAULT False prevents NULLs. Retiring old version before the contract NOT NULL step ensures the gate sees old_alive=false.
revision_notes: Moved the contract SQL stage (ALTER ... SET NOT NULL) to after the retire_old stage. The prior plan had contract before retire_old, which caused the retirement_gate to refuse because the old version was still active. Relocating retire_old before contract ensures old_alive=false when the contract check runs.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with DEFAULT FALSE to account_user
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;

stages.description: Explicitly backfill marketing_opt_in to False for all rows

sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
